candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year ended December 31, 2025, AS Merko Ehitus reported consolidated revenue of EUR 310.9 million, representing a significant decline of 42.3% compared to EUR 539.0 million in the previous year.
Gross profit fell from EUR 95.9 million to EUR 55.9 million, while the gross margin remained relatively stable at 18.0%, compared with 17.8% in 2024.
Operating profit declined to EUR 34.3 million from EUR 72.5 million, resulting in an operating profit margin of 11.0% versus 13.4% in the prior year.
Net profit attributable to equity holders of the parent decreased to EUR 39.9 million compared to EUR 64.7 million in 2024, yielding a net margin of 12.8% compared to 12.0% previously.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 2025 revenue decline was driven by the completion of major projects initiated in prior years during 2025, combined with a slower pace of new contract signing in 2024 and the first half of 2025; this project cycle effect compressed profitability despite eventual improvement in contract signing activity later in 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statement of the Chairman of the Management Board: 'In 2024, we were engaged in several large projects that had been started in earlier years, and these were completed as planned during 2025. The pace of signing new contracts was slower in 2024 and in the first half of 2025.'

candidate_sentences.text: The decrease in top-line performance was primarily driven by lower activity in the construction service segment as several major projects completed in 2024 were finalized, coupled with a slower pace of signing new contracts during 2024 and the first half of 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: A major improvement in contract signing during the second half of 2025 resulted in the execution of Merko's largest-ever contracts for the Rūdninkai defence campus in Lithuania, which will contribute gradually to revenue starting in 2026 and provide stable workload for years ahead.

candidate_sentences.text: Notably, the second half of 2025 marked a clear operational improvement, highlighted by the preparation for major contracts, including significant defense campus projects in Lithuania secured subsequently.
